en: A black‑and‑white panoramic cityscape of a European spa town nestled in a narrow valley with forested hills in the background. The foreground shows richly ornamented late‑19th‑century apartment and hotel buildings, with mansard roofs and elaborate facades. In the mid‑ground stands a small towered structure and dense rows of multi‑storey townhouses stepping up the hillside. At the top of the hill a small lookout pavilion or chapel sits on a rocky outcrop. The overall look suggests a historic resort city built along a river, photographed from an elevated vantage point.
